title: PDAC 2027 Convention
whatIsHappening: PDAC 2027 Convention (7–10 March 2027, MTCC) publishes Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown as an official hotel partner with promo rate CAD $449 and reference code for direct booking (cutoff 2 Feb 2027). Limited availability remains on select nights.
whyThisHotel: 157 guestrooms / ~11,000 sq ft / 20 meeting rooms on Queens Quay — realistic for mid-size groups, overflow, and meeting+rooms packages; not exclusive MTCC mega-housing. PDAC official partner list includes this hotel at 8-minute walk to MTCC.
potentialHotelBusiness: Fill remaining partner-rate inventory; pursue exhibitor/company suites and overflow once partner nights sell; do not confuse with exclusive venue housing.
whyActNow: Partner promo cutoff 2 Feb 2027; limited availability already flagged on select nights.
recommendedNextStep: Qualify before pursuing — a Radisson Blu participant/partner listing already exists, so this is account management of an existing listing rather than new prospecting. Use the published organizational route convention@pdac.ca and start with Nicole Sampson (Senior Director, Convention, Prospectors & Developers Association of Canada) to review how the existing Radisson Blu listing for PDAC 2027 Convention (Mar 7–10, 2027) is performing (pickup, release dates, remaining inventory) and what extra rooms or meeting space the organizer needs. A verified personal email for Nicole Sampson was not published on the staff materials reviewed.
uncertainties: No date-by-date available Radisson rooms, contracted allocation, pickup, total event room nights or peak-room demand were found in the public materials reviewed. No verified 2027 attendance forecast: the homepage describes a 32,000+ audience, while the 2027 statistics URL repeats historical 2026 figures and explicitly references 2026; 32,155 must not be represented as confirmed 2027 attendance.
Contact audit (2026-11-16): Nicole Sampson, Senior Director, Convention — role consistent with lodging/meetings buying; route: no email published.

Not Sales Ready: No usable contact route (no published email, phone or contact page attached to the named contact). Radisson Blu already appears as a published participant/partner hotel — this is account management of an existing listing, not a new Sales Ready prospect.
lodgingEvidence: Edition-specific PDAC 2027 Hotel Partners page publishes direct hotel booking routes and promotional rates/blocks. Exact instruction: “Book directly with your hotel(s) of choice using the links we provide above.” Exact responsibility statement: “PDAC does not manage hotel reservations and does NOT use 3rd party housing bureaus.” All 17 listed hotels: Crowne Plaza Toronto Airport; Chelsea Hotel, Toronto; Hotel X Toron
